import re as re_module

r = await world.call('repo.read_file', **{'path': 'semver.py'})
raw = r['content']

# Strip line numbers
lines = raw.split('\n')
clean_lines = []
for line in lines:
    m = re_module.match(r'^\s*\d+\t(.*)$', line)
    if m:
        clean_lines.append(m.group(1))
    else:
        clean_lines.append(line)

clean_content = '\n'.join(clean_lines)

# 7. bump_prerelease function
clean_content = clean_content.replace(
    "'3.4.5-dev.1'\n    \"\"\"\n    verinfo = parse(version)\n    verinfo[\"prerelease\"] = _increment_string(",
    "'3.4.5-dev.1'\n    \"\"\"\n    warnings.warn(\n        \"semver.bump_prerelease is deprecated. Use VersionInfo.bump_prerelease() instead.\",\n        DeprecationWarning,\n        stacklevel=2,\n    )\n    verinfo = parse(version)\n    verinfo[\"prerelease\"] = _increment_string("
)

# 8. bump_build function
clean_content = clean_content.replace(
    "'3.4.5-rc.1+build.10'\n    \"\"\"\n    verinfo = parse(version)\n    verinfo[\"build\"] = _increment_string(verinfo[\"build\"] or (token or \"build\") + \".0\")",
    "'3.4.5-rc.1+build.10'\n    \"\"\"\n    warnings.warn(\n        \"semver.bump_build is deprecated. Use VersionInfo.bump_build() instead.\",\n        DeprecationWarning,\n        stacklevel=2,\n    )\n    verinfo = parse(version)\n    verinfo[\"build\"] = _increment_string(verinfo[\"build\"] or (token or \"build\") + \".0\")"
)

# 9. finalize_version function
clean_content = clean_content.replace(
    "'1.2.3'\n    \"\"\"\n    verinfo = parse(version)\n    return format_version(verinfo[\"major\"], verinfo[\"minor\"], verinfo[\"patch\"])",
    "'1.2.3'\n    \"\"\"\n    warnings.warn(\n        \"semver.finalize_version is deprecated. Use VersionInfo.replace() instead.\",\n        DeprecationWarning,\n        stacklevel=2,\n    )\n    verinfo = parse(version)\n    return format_version(verinfo[\"major\"], verinfo[\"minor\"], verinfo[\"patch\"])"
)

# 10. replace function
clean_content = clean_content.replace(
    "'2.2.10'\n    \"\"\"\n    version = parse_version_info(version)\n    return str(version.replace(**parts))",
    "'2.2.10'\n    \"\"\"\n    warnings.warn(\n        \"semver.replace is deprecated. Use VersionInfo.replace() instead.\",\n        DeprecationWarning,\n        stacklevel=2,\n    )\n    version = parse_version_info(version)\n    return str(version.replace(**parts))"
)

print("Done with second batch")
for func_name in ['bump_prerelease', 'bump_build', 'finalize_version', 'replace']:
    print(f"{func_name}: {'deprecated' in clean_content}")

# Write back
r = await world.call('repo.write_file', **{'path': 'semver.py', 'content': clean_content})
print(r['ok'], r.get('error', ''))
